title: Minimum Score of a Path Between Two Cities
goal: Minimize the smallest road weight encountered on a walk from city one to city n.
strategy: Walks may repeat roads and vertices, so any edge in city one connected component can be visited as a detour before reaching city n. The smallest weight anywhere in that component is attainable.

edgeCases: A smaller edge in another component is irrelevant
